title: AppFlowy — Notion Test
script: I rebuilt the same small workspace in AppFlowy and Notion. A table, board, calendar, project page, and form. If a feature was unavailable, I marked it. Then I disconnected the test device and tried opening, editing, and saving the workspace. I also exported the data and opened it elsewhere. A download is not enough if fields disappear. [OFFLINE_AND_EXPORT_RESULTS]. [TEAM_AND_FEATURE_LIMITS]. [WHO_SHOULD_SWITCH_AND_WHO_SHOULD_STAY]. What would your workspace need?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Table, Kanban, calendar, page/form; offline, export and team tests.
whyNow: A practical alternative deserves a current, version-specific check before a viewer changes workflow.
viewerGoal: Decide whether this recorded workflow fits their own devices, plan and needs.
hooks: I rebuilt the same small workspace in AppFlowy and Notion.
The network is off. Can the workspace still save?
The export downloaded. Did the data survive?
strongestHook: I rebuilt the same small workspace in AppFlowy and Notion.
directorBrief: Direct this as a fair matched test with a scoped recommendation: Table, Kanban, calendar, page/form; offline, export and team tests. Keep real app interaction dominant. The final verdict depends on who can use the tool for this recorded workflow, not a universal winner. Capture version, OS and plan so the evidence can be interpreted.
effort: 30–90 minutes capture/test; large transfers and export waiting may add elapsed time.
protocol: Build the same five-row project dataset and attachments in AppFlowy and Notion. Attempt table, board, calendar, project page and form; record availability by plan. Disconnect an isolated test device, open/edit/save, reconnect and inspect persistence/conflicts. Export, parse and count rows/properties/attachments independently. Invite a second test account only if available and authorized; otherwise mark team test unperformed. Report offline/export fidelity and actual gaps.
evidenceRequirements: Check actual working outputs and data fidelity.

music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
